description: This tool finds an occupation by name or code, lists the fields the federal crosswalk links to it, and returns up to 10 programs in those fields with their published four-year earnings.

occupation.description: Occupation name or code, for example registered nurses or 29-1141.

state.description: Two-letter state code, for example CA.

name: find_programs_for_career
title: Find programs for a career
